title: The research queue's ql_research.NOTE does not read a Closed note, so querylog.py queue keeps a _gaps.md entry the router reads as closed
goal: ql_research.NOTE and SETTLED read a '- Closed <date>:' note under a _gaps.md entry as settling it, as kbfacts.OPEN_GAP does (13 Closed notes in kb/public/_gaps.md), and kb/_self/querylog.md says which notes settle an entry for the queue; whether Narrowed and Partly resolved settle it for the queue too is a gate before the start: the repro exits 0

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_research as q;m=q.NOTE.match('  - Closed 2026-10-10: answered');print('Closed note read:',bool(m and m.group(1) in q.SETTLED));sys.exit(0 if m and m.group(1) in q.SETTLED else 1)
